global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, menma, naruto fish cake, and a vibrant red fish cake ball. A nori sheet rests beside it, all nestled in a white bowl with red trim, set on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with visible texture and natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red double rim and red Japanese characters, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with red fish cake, green herbs, and white onion slices, appears rich and savory.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, triangular, with a glossy, slightly uneven surface and visible texture.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice: translucent, tender, curved, with visible fat marbling and green herb specks on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as light brown, slightly curved, with visible speckles and a glossy surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: translucent pink swirls in pale white, speckled with green herbs, glossy surface.
